notes.title: Patch & "Creative Break"
notes.content:
Hey my Home Survival players,

Through some testing, I was able to fix a few bugs and I must confess that this will be one of the last bug fixes in HOME Survival for now. Unfortunately, I'm stuck with some blueprints and FPS bugs, and I'm wasting time and patience.

So, I'm taking a "creative break" from HOME development and devoting my thoughts and time to a new project. I hope to gain new insights and use them later in HOME.

THANKS to all the playtesters and also to all of you who have supported me over the years. ːsteamthumbsupː

Best regards

Thomas van Geffen
Own Creations Game Studios

Bug Fixes

[list]
[*]Fixed bugs in the forge and workbench: Recipe for iron ingots and iron bars
[*] Fixed information display errors. Information is now better highlighted.
[*] Fixed a bug with my respawn bed. Players can now set their respawn point again.
[*] Fixed an error after respawning the minimap and map.
[/list]

ːsteamhappyːWe'll see you again and we won't give up on the project. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update: Alpha 0.036
notes.content:
Hey you survivalists,
After a long, long, long time, a major update is coming. You always notice that I'm working on the game all by myself and that my talent in developing games still has a lot of room for improvement. Today I present to you a major bug fix with some adjustments. 

Thanks for any support!

Best regards
Thomas van Geffen

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/TwdYvdcb/TITELBILD-0-036.png[/img]

[*] Deer built into the home screen

Best regards
Thomas van Geffen
